dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, serrated perimeters with a sharp high-contrast gradient transitioning from a dark exterior to a variegated light-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of amorphous, high-intensity pixel clusters is visible on the mid-to-posterior lateral side, forming interconnected, non-geometric light patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two primary 'O' rings in the dorsal-center and the centroid of the large anterior 'C' structure form an obtuse scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pigmented digits/claws are visible on the anterior flipper, contrasting sharply with the surrounding high-intensity fur texture.
